pages.title: Create the Simulated Furnace
pages.text: Use a spawner while holding Primordial Qi in the main hand and a Spirit Core in the offhand. Put a spawn egg or filled Soul Catcher in processing. The weapon slot contributes to the real loot table, attacker, and luck calculation. One cycle takes 50 ticks.

pages.title: One Stack, One Settlement
pages.text: Processing-stack count is the cycle multiplier: ten specimens create ten times the result in one settlement, not ten repeated logic passes. Specimens are not consumed one by one. With Xianqiao Output enabled and a valid owner, the complete batch commits atomically to that owner's Xianqiao without occupying the local 4x3 output area first.

pages.title: Simulated Spirit Field
pages.text: One recipe yields four fields. Insert a seed and the machine calls its real crop loot once every 50 ticks. Use valid soil, farmland, End Stone-like, or Soul Sand-like blocks to replace the substrate; the old block returns to inventory first.

pages.title: Seeds and Substrates
pages.text: Seed-stack count likewise multiplies one result. Chorus Fruit requires End Stone and has a base cycle of one Chorus Flower plus two Chorus Fruit. Nether Wart requires a Soul Sand-like substrate. Datapacks may extend seed, crop, and substrate catalogues.

pages.title: Tool Slot, Plugin Slot
pages.text: The field tool slot and furnace weapon slot also hold the plugin; no extra slot is added. A tool or weapon contributes its loot modifiers. A plugin instead multiplies one output by 4, 16, or 256. Stack and plugin multipliers settle together, without changing fuel duration.

pages.title: Fuel and Input Faces
pages.text: True Yuan supplies 50 burn ticks and Immortal Yuan 500. A claimed Spirit Drive may keep paying from its owner. Specimens enter from above and fuel from horizontal faces. Products enter the local cache only while Xianqiao Output is disabled. If one result exceeds free space, the machine first sends that excess through enabled accepting faces; every rejected stack remains intact in a persistent temporary cache and never becomes a production drop.

pages.title: Two Output Routes
pages.text: Xianqiao Output and Automatic Output are independent. Enabling Xianqiao Output first flushes existing local products to the owner; every later batch goes directly to Xianqiao without checking local capacity or creating overflow drops. If Xianqiao is unavailable or rejects the complete batch, the result remains pending intact and processing waits—nothing falls back locally or ejects. In local mode, newly freed ordinary cache space is filled from the temporary cache first. No new cycle starts until it is empty; processing resumes on the tick it clears. Automatic Output only pushes local cache through enabled faces.

pages.title: Ownership
pages.text: Inside a personal Xianqiao, the realm owner wins. Outside it, only a claimed Spirit Drive in the fuel slot provides an owner. Without a reliable owner, Xianqiao Output is unavailable, while local production and manual collection continue normally.
